name: Colorado
short: Xcel Energy pays $750 per heating ton for a cold-climate heat pump, and $1,500 per ton for homes heated with Xcel gas from October 1, 2026. A heat pump water heater gets $750 or $1,500, a smart thermostat $50 and a home EV charger up to $500. Solar has no upfront rebate for most homes in 2026, and the federal credits ended after 2025. Colorado Springs and Fort Collins have their own utilities with different programs that we are still checking.
